OpenCapt Quick Start

1) Run opencapt.exe. The app stays in tray (no main window).
2) Default capture hotkey: Ctrl+Shift+A
3) Config file: .\\config.toml (same folder as opencapt.exe).
4) Logs directory: .\\logs
5) If the exe folder is not writable, OpenCapt falls back to %APPDATA%\\OpenCapt\\config.toml.
6) If OCR is enabled, set API key and model config in config.toml.
